scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n STUDIO,LAUNCHER -c magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix greenblox-studio" "npm run dev --prefix \"greenblox launcher\""
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix greenblox-studio && npm run build --prefix "greenblox launcher"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n STUDIO,LAUNCHER -c magenta,green "npm run start --prefix greenblox-studio" "npm run preview --prefix \"greenblox launcher\" -- --port 5173"
